annotations.title: Factor board: what followed days like today across recorded metrics

description: Call this when the user asks which indicators currently sit in an unusual band, whether a metric's current level historically preceded BTC moves, or for a cross-metric conditional overview. Returns every recorded metric in its historical band with the median 7-day BTC move that followed versus the base rate, with an n >= 30 gate; distributions, not forecasts. Without limit the first 40 rows in the board's own order (rows_total counts every row, trimmed names the cut); pass limit up to 400 for the whole board. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.
